'''Federica Sallusto''' (born 27 November 1961) is an Italian-Swiss [[biologist]] and immunologist.
After high school, she studied Biology at [[Sapienza - University of Rome]] where she graduated ''[[cum laude]]''. She earned her PhD in biology in 1988 from the University of  Sapienza, followed by two postdoctoral fellowships at the National Italian Institute of Health in Rome, Italy (1989–91) and the Basel Institute of Immunology in Basel, Switzerland (1993–95).<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae Prof. Dr. Federica Sallusto |url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Sallusto_Federica_EN.pdf |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240904182049/https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Sallusto_Federica_EN.pdf |archive-date=2024-09-04 |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=www.leopoldina.org |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 1999, Sallusto, alongside [[David Dombrowicz]], was awarded the Pharmacia Allergy Research Foundation Award, which is given annually to researchers under the age of 40 who are working on IgE‐associated disease.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=O'Byrne |first1=P. M. |title=Pharmacia Allergy Research Foundation and its Award for Young Scientists in Allergy Research |journal=Allergy |date=March 2005 |volume=60 |issue=3 |pages=269–270 |doi=10.1111/j.1398-9995.2005.00800.x |pmid=15679710 |doi-access=}}</ref> In 2009, Sallusto was invited to give the Novartis Behring Lecture,<ref>{{Cite web |last=Switzerland |first=Albadream Engineering-Software development in Lugano |date=2009-11-25 |title=Federica Sallusto Gives the Novartis Behring Lecture |url=https://irb.usi.ch/news/federica-sallusto-gives-the-novartis-behring-lecture/ |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=IRB USI |language=en-US}}</ref> which is a prestigious annual award that is given to an exceptional scientist in the field of virology, immunology or microbiology.

Sallusto was the president of the Swiss Society of Allergology and Immunology from 2013-15. Currently, she is group leader at the [[Institute for Research in Biomedicine]] in [[Bellinzona]], [[Switzerland]]<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.cdt.ch/ticino/medicina-ecco-dove-ci-portera-la-ricerca-AJ586417| work=Corriere del Ticino|accessdate=6 January 2018 |language=italian| title=Medicina, ecco dove ci porterà la ricerca| date=13 December 2018 |first=Paolo Rossi |last=Castelli}}</ref> since 2000, Director of the Center of Medical Immunology and Head of the Cellular Immunology Laboratory at the [[Institute for Research in Biomedicine]] (IRB) since 2016, and a professor of Medical Immunology at the [[ETH Zurich|Swiss Federal Institute of Technology]] (ETH) Zurich, Switzerland since 2017.<ref name=":0" /> Sallusto is a member of the Scientific Advisory Board at the [[University of Basel|University of Babel]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Advisory Board {{!}} Department of Biomedicine {{!}} University of Basel |url=https://biomedizin.unibas.ch/en/about-us/advisory-board/ |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=biomedizin.unibas.ch |language=en-US}}</ref>

== Research ==
Sallusto's research focuses on the role of [[dendritic cell]]s and [[T cell]]s in immune system responses, with special attention to the [[T helper cell]]s Th1, Th2, [[T helper 17 cell|Th17]] and [[Th22 cell|Th22]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Federica Sallusto |url=https://www.efis.org/about/board/federica-sallusto |access-date=2025-03-17 |website=European Federation of Immunological Societies |language=en}}</ref> Her work was the first to characterize antigen-specific [[memory T cell]]s as "effector memory T cells" (TEM) and "central memory T cells" (TCM).<ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Sallusto |first1=Federica |last2=Lenig |first2=Danielle |last3=Förster |first3=Reinhold |last4=Lipp |first4=Martin |last5=Lanzavecchia |first5=Antonio |date=October 1999 |title=Two subsets of memory T lymphocytes with distinct homing potentials and effector functions |url=https://www.nature.com/articles/44385 |journal=Nature |language=en |volume=401 |issue=6754 |pages=708–712 |doi=10.1038/44385 |pmid=10537110 |bibcode=1999Natur.401..708S |issn=1476-4687|url-access=subscription }}</ref>
